Study Sprint: three layouts for Clinical A

The owner picked A and asked for versions with different layouts, less "AI modern techy". A1, A2 and A3 use exactly A's colours, type and tokens; only the page structure changes, and all three drop the rounded pills, the goal ring and the decorative icons. Each is a real stylesheet on the live app (origin/main, v4.9), screenshotted with seeded medical decks. Every visible text node passes WCAG AA in light and dark, and no screen scrolls sideways at 375 or 1440 px wide.

Implementation notes

Shared by A1, A2 and A3

  • layout-common.css (~100 lines) sits on top of A: 4px corners, no logo mark, no nav icons, exam countdowns as coloured text, "Study" / "Done" / "73% mastered" in words.
  • Markup: the goal ring becomes "6 of 94 done today" and a thin bar (js/today.js, the ring() call in the hero). Plus A's shared changes from round 3 (Style row, "All done for today", "Extra study").

DOM versus CSS only

  • A1: CSS only (~80 lines). The right-hand exam column is a CSS grid on the existing Today markup.
  • A2: CSS only (~125 lines). Moving the sidebar into a header bar is CSS, but the deck list and sync line are hidden on desktop.
  • A3: CSS only (~125 lines). Phones reorder Today with CSS order; Today's "Your decks" is hidden on desktop because the pane lists them. Review side by side uses the existing back-face markup.

Checks

  • Rendered-text contrast on all 80 shots: no failures. Colour tokens are A's (0 failing pairs, ui3/contrast.mjs).
  • No horizontal scroll on any shot.
  • Shots are the first viewport (375 x 812, 1440 x 900).
